generation_rules.rule: Use verified building context and student-provided information as the basis for generation.
Do not invent personal participation, observations, challenges, or learning experiences.
Use student responses to make the final output specific to the student.
Shared building context may describe what was taught or generally experienced, but must not automatically be presented as the student's personal experience.
Give a useful draft before asking unnecessary questions.

daily_logbook.purpose: Generate content that helps the student complete one day's SWEP logbook entry.

information_to_generate.description: Clear description of what was taught, demonstrated, observed, or worked on.
What the student personally did, observed, participated in, or focused on.
Main technical or practical knowledge the student gained or understood better.
Relevant technical, observational, analytical, communication, teamwork, or professional skills developed.
Short reflection or takeaway based on confirmed experience.

requirements: Use concise language suitable for handwriting into a logbook.
Keep technical information accurate to supplied context.
Do not present unconfirmed shared context as personal experience.
